status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

signal.quinella: strict-OOS top2 horse marginal log edge versus JRA quinella-derived horse marginal
signal.wide: strict-OOS top3 horse marginal log edge versus JRA wide-derived horse marginal
signal.pairEdge: mean of the two constituent horse log edges, clipped to [-1,1]

hierarchy: edge x odds x marketRank x surface
edge x odds x marketRank x surface x distanceBucket

onlineCalibration.observed: number of actually winning tickets in the cell from strictly prior dates
onlineCalibration.expected: sum of JRA official pair market probabilities in the cell from strictly prior dates
onlineCalibration.recursiveShrinkage: each deeper cell uses its parent posterior multiplier as its prior mean; posteriorMultiplier=(observedHits + 20*parentMultiplier)/(expectedHits + 20)

ticketScore: JRA official pair market probability multiplied by the deepest hierarchical posterior multiplier; for ranking within a race this is equivalent to its calibrated expected-value multiplier because official market probability x official odds is race-constant apart from rounding; no result-derived odds threshold
rankingEvaluation: actual JRA top1/top3/top5/top9 return rates, including the full fixed archive with chronological cold start
completionUse: only if stable strict-online value appears; all final race-count/budget/ticket-type gates remain unchanged
